Trying to find the difference between leading politicians in Israel is like
sorting M&M's: they look different on the outside, but they're all the same on
the inside. The top contenders to replace Benjamin Netanyahu, in fact, offer
very little to hope for, especially on Palestinian statehood and an end to the
occupation, and some even position themselves further right than the current
prime minister, who is [wanted](https://www.icc-cpi.int/defendant/netanyahu)
by the International Criminal Court on war crimes charges.
